rapport_notes: Patient and unflustered through extensive customer math confusion and a double-move insurance-documentation request, keeping a warm, helpful tone throughout.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators were repeated because none were said at all; no open-ended rubric questions (agenda, 'does that feel fair') were asked so no silence to hold or lose.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: "I did a research, and yeah, and they said that company a scam..." / Jules: "Got it, okay. Oh, no. Oh, that's why I'm so sorry about that." — acknowledged, then moved straight to sending the email with no follow-up question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "You only pay after everything is completed with the actual time used for the move... you'll only pay up to this fifteen minute mark." — covers the pay-less-if-faster idea; the other four Save Your Ass lines are not covered.

top_strength: Patiently walked the customer through repeated pricing math corrections and adapted on the fly to produce a written itemized quote for her insurance adjuster.
coaching_note: Never asked 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns' and skipped every differentiator (careful-with, meet-your-mover, on-time guarantee, communication) plus most of the Save Your Ass and close framework — build these in even on a heavily transactional, price-focused call.
